_comment: The film's vehicles (Oct 20 2026). Models: tools/house/purchased_vehicles.py -> unity/HomeAlone/Assets/Purchased/Vehicles/<kind>.glb (CC-BY Sketchfab downloads, gitignored, CREDITS.md). Prefabs: Editor/VehiclePrefabs.Build() -> Assets/Purchased/Vehicles/<kind>.prefab (root at the ground contact, nose +z, metres), which the neighbourhood's swap hook instances in place of the nb_life proxy of the same kind. Positions are NOT here: tools/house/nb_life.py layout() (life_layout.json items) owns them, each with its film evidence; checked against these models below.

Car_CapricePolice.film: 11574-11636 (night): two 1987-90 Chevrolet Caprice cruisers at the Murphys', navy with a light belt band, POLICE on the front fender band, the Winnetka shield on the front doors, a chrome bar of two MARS beacons + two round flashers + a siren speaker, all red
Car_CapricePolice.placement_check: nb_life: (39.9, 12.2) heading (0.5, 0.866) and (60.3, 18.4) heading (0.96, -0.28), back-projected through the film 11581 camera with a 5.4 m proxy; these models are 5.39 m with the same ground origin: no change

Car_RamVan.film: 3297/3299 and 5696 (night, at our kerb), 6830 (day, passenger side, the clearest), 3510-3520 (the face): a grey-blue Dodge Ram Van cargo body, no side glass, ladder rack with buckets and pipe, RAM fender badge, Oh-Kay Plumbing & Heating lettering on both sides
Car_RamVan.placement_check: nb_life: (31.75, 28.4) heading (0, -1): nose at z 25.9, 1.7 m past our lamp post (z 24.2) as in 3297/3299 where the van's nose stops just past the post; same 5.0 m length as the proxy: no change. Note: the film shows it at our house only at night (3297, 3489-3536, 5539-5559, 5692-5702, 9510-9551); by day it is elsewhere (6809-6835)

Car_Caprice.film: 1884/1888 (day): a blue full-size sedan at our kerb; the same 1987 Caprice body, plain mid-blue paint (shade by eye, distant), no bar, unlit lamps
Car_Caprice.placement_check: nb_life: (31.65, 46.5) heading (0, 1), z a guess (G); same size as the proxy

materials._note: HDRP Lit per VEH_* glTF material (VehiclePrefabs.Hdrp). The base colour map comes from the GLB. coat > 0 = HDRP Lit clear coat (the Unity 6 HDRP way for car paint at game cost; StackLit's dual-lobe coat is ~2x the shading cost). mask: R metallic, G AO, A smoothness (grime rougher), linear. emissive_nits: _EmissiveColor in nits (the house's lamp globes are 4000).
